notes.title: Release information and more teasers
notes.notes:
I just started working on the final chapter of Season 2, and if it takes roughly as long as previous chapters it should be ready in February or March, meaning that we're probably looking at a March release here on Steam. This is just preliminary however so take it with a grain of salt, I'll post another announcement when I have a more concrete release date.

The price will be the same as Season 1, however you'll be getting a lot more content at a significantly higher quality, early impressions have been very favorable so I'm positive that you'll be pleased with what's provided.

Quality takes time, and I want it to be as high quality as possible. Have some additional teasers as thanks for your patience! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863160/Projekt_Passion__Season_2/]Do consider wishlisting[/url]

notes.title: Season 2 teasers, and a big thank you!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Though I don't think my regular development logs are appropriate for Steam announcements, I feel that my Steam audience has deserved a bit of an update on the progress on Season 2. But first of all I want to give a big thank you to everyone who has decided to support me by playing my game, it has gone better than I ever imagined and I'm so glad that most of you seem to have enjoyed it.

Season 2 is underway and progress is nice and steady. I am currently close to finishing the third part, Season 1 consisted of seven parts and I expect that to be the case for Season 2 as well. I am working as hard as I can to have it finished in late 2024 but I can't make any promises yet.

Anyway here are some teasers to prove that I'm actually working on it.

notes.title: 0.7.3 - Gallery fix
notes.notes:
Some players had their galleries wiped clean after the 0.7.2 update, this update is mainly to fix that.

- If you've lost gallery entries, load the latest save you have and the game should restore everything you had unlocked until that save point (it might miss an entry or two but hopefully not).

- There is a Sync Achievements button in Options if this causes you to not achieve Steam achievements.

- Removed the Skip button during cutscenes since it caused them to loop endlessly after the engine update.

I apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused. Consider blaming the silly game engine, rather than the silly game developer who's trying his best :)

Stay classy

notes.title: 0.7.2 - French and Spanish (Latin) translation
notes.notes:
Hi all! French and Spanish translations are now available. That's all really.

Stay classy!

notes.title: 0.7.1 - Turkish translation and some smaller changes
notes.notes:
Hello all! A few updates to the game has been added

- Turkish translation is now available in the Options menu.

- Some improvements to the Italian translation have been made.

- There is now a Sync Steam Achievements button in the Options menu, this will sync your achievements with Steam in case you previously unlocked them in a non-Steam version of the game.

Upcoming translations are French and Spanish (Latin America).

That's it for now, cheers and take care!

notes.title: Introducing: Vesnia
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/e1fe2c5f7792c377089c001535ab1f65fa63d4ab.png[/img]
Meet Vesnia, good friend/seductive bartender/succubus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/136c3fe3f9b51b6971bb47149366bb4dddb2e32d.png[/img]
She's a longtime friend of yours, and a bartender at Club Horizon, which might as well be your second home. Like all of us, she hates her job, and her boss, and everything else that has to do with her job. She's also very sexy and seductive, which makes her even more relatable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/e1d992b247271d272edaddef423b548d599e31f8.jpg[/img]
But her job might not be the only thing she hates. There might be more to her story that she's not telling. What is it that she keeps under her counter? Dark secrets? A tragic past? A shotgun? Play the game and maybe she'll let you know.

Play the game and get to know her. Releasing May 26.

notes.title: Introducing: Emily
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/86506a7bfe7d007fec8fa6081966bf7c3eeead98.jpg[/img]
Meet Emily, the intern with a love for guns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/1aaa16679897bbf1e8388d72677f434dfb29057d.png[/img]
You meet her early on when she's still an intern for the enemy, but that's evidently not a life suited for her so she chooses to walk down a different path. Also they left her behind, that might have something to do with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/e0a03e01d1549d920eb2d664cc29c81caf359246.jpg[/img]
She has a big interest in all kinds of guns, rifles, firearms, pistols, muskets, cannons, and miscellaneous ranged weapons. But despite this interest, she's still a kindhearted and innocent soul, not at all excessively violent. Or is she? Maybe on the surface.

Play the game and get to know her true nature. Releasing May 26.

notes.title: Introducing: Elysra
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/09dad4713831d136075176bf3c21944524b33eaa.jpg[/img]
Meet Elysra, the blind pilot (whose genius idea was this?).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/ed64dd23f8a6f9aacbb53753d36ff8c601df607b.jpg[/img]
Okay she's not actually blind. She wears a blindfold because she has a condition called Spiritsight, which causes humans to faint by looking into her eyes. She can see through it though so don't worry about crashing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/f8d7d46cba6afac756c97d3633f6e8e179c98925.jpg[/img]
She joins your crew after you put up an online ad looking for a pilot to fly your nice new ship. She'll eventually grow to be a core part of the team, and not only because of her flying skills. But are there more secrets hidden behind that blindfold? Play to get to know her and find out!

notes.title: Introducing: SAndrA
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/20d6db1886eff9e8c6fb4081d8e0ef1b3e738ec1.jpg[/img]
Meet SAndrA, your very own sexbot... sorry, administrative assistant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/3926fe18f2f3e5146bab07179bb47862db5e4b60.jpg[/img]
Her name stands for Subservient Android Assistant, and she joins you early on after you "accidentally" kill her previous owner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/47ba5ac58e77ffb27debd20c85629cf0ddbcf49c.jpg[/img]
Though her android model actually defines her as a sexbot, she has only ever been used for administrative purposes. It's up to you whether you want to reawaken her sexual urges, or if you want her to keep acting solely as your assistant.

notes.title: Introducing: Kaylee
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/b7e43c5d5203d8c51cdb92b1c519d88377a95bf3.jpg[/img]
Kaylee, your childhood friend and most loyal companion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/ae448fa97c17b8baa3135c3c98379aefde2dbf95.jpg[/img]
She is the instigator of this mission of yours, though she graciously chooses to give leadership over to you, yet still relying on her cool-headedness and reasonable mind to keep you in line. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/52c9463545bb8c2fa3233f15d0fc7a4fc47f528c.jpg[/img]
She may have begun this adventure, but does she have what it takes to actually finish it? Does she have the skill required? The will? Play and find out who she is, and what she's capable of.

notes.title: Introducing: Ashe
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/438a8163395b81872c928332d6a01d88cbf7a07f.jpg[/img]
Ashe, the space ninja... no, assassin. Or was it ninja? No, it's assassin. She's a space assassin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/13d985942f1a57d1bd9b7201c65f03cec36d2dc3.jpg[/img]
She joins your crew early on, for professional reasons ONLY. But despite her initial reluctance to get to know you, she continually proves to be a valuable asset of the team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162735/2fb333f858a599c8fb985dff3875b4af5abace75.jpg[/img]
She's a reclusive girl, but it's evident that there's much more to her personality than she lets on. So what's the reason for her cold and silent nature? What's the story behind it? Play to get to know her further and develop a deeper relationship with her.
